title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1973-09-15

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jazz‑heavy second set with killer Keith solo and soaring horns on Let It Grow, Eyes of the World and Truckin’>Eyes>Let Me Sing Your Blues Away.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is crystal clear and typical of the strong ’73 board mixes, letting listeners hear every horn blast and Keith’s incendiary solo. Musically the show is a high‑energy, jazz‑infused romp – the horns turn Let It Grow and the Eyes of the World jam into standout moments, while the second‑set flow stays tight and exhilarating.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.6/5 with consistent praise for both performance and sound quality; weighting favors the stellar show (70%) and excellent recording (30%).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix typical of 1973 SBDs; reviewers note no drop‑outs or muddiness and praise the overall fidelity.

standout_songs: Truckin' > Eyes of the World > Let Me Sing Your Blues Away
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly with extended jazz jams; horns are woven into transitions, especially between Let It Grow and Stella Blue, creating a cohesive, exploratory arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals praised as “blow me away”; no specific guitar comments beyond general excitement.
band_member_comments.Keys: Multiple reviewers highlight a “killer Keith solo” and overall keyboard brilliance during the horn‑driven jams.
